note: Plain-language summaries written from each link's evidence list. Each sentence must be backed by an evidence item or caveat in links.json. Later this file can be produced by the Claude API from the same evidence.

calcs.loads/roof-dead-live: Flat-roof dead load build-up (roofing, membrane, Densglass, insulation, deck, framing allowances) used for deck, beams, girders, columns and seismic weight.
calcs.gravity/roof-risafloor: RISAFloor gravity model of the roof (2021): member sketches, then the roof sections of the point, beam, design, shear, bending, deflection and end-reaction tables.
calcs.gravity/level2-risafloor: RISAFloor gravity model of Level 2 (2021): sketches and the Level 2 sections of the model tables.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-a-1-s4.0.1: ENERCALC check of HSS header (A) at section 1/S4.0.1, strong and weak axis – HSS12x6x5/16.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-b-2-s4.0.1-a: ENERCALC check of HSS header (B) at section 2/S4.0.1 (variant A), strong axis – HSS10x6x3/8.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-b-2-s4.0.1: ENERCALC check of HSS header (B) at section 2/S4.0.1, weak axis – HSS10x6x3/8.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-d-1-s4.0.2: ENERCALC check of HSS header (D) at section 1/S4.0.2, strong and weak axis – HSS10x6x3/8.
calcs.studs/hss-hdr-2-s4.0.2-la-cantina: ENERCALC check of the La Cantina HSS header at section 2/S4.0.2 – HSS10x6x1/2.
calcs.studs/hss-jamb-1-s4.0.1: ENERCALC check of the HSS jamb at section 1/S4.0.1 – HSS8x6x3/8, combined axial + bending.
calcs.stair/grid-6-e-f: Stair at grid 6 between E and F (MV-NS): framing sketch, landing angle design, seismic anchorage and ENERCALC check of support beam B1 (cantilever diaphragm).
calcs.stair/grid-5-a: Stair at grid 5 / A: framing sketch, landing angle design, seismic anchorage and ENERCALC check of support beam B2.
calcs.parapet/hss-posts: Parapet design (8/7/2023): section at grid B & 4, wind on the parapet, HSS post and connection checks, angle design.
calcs.general/cover-toc: Cover sheet and table of contents of the 2021 KPFF package (sections A–E). Not a calc; listed so every page belongs somewhere.
calcs.loads/floor-dead-live: Floor dead load build-up for Level 2 (tile, deck, 3.25" LWT topping, overpour, MEP, ceiling) and live loads. The sheet is headed 'Dana Point Harbor (Bldg 10)'.
calcs.loads/balcony-dead-live: Exterior balcony dead loads (4" paving, waterproofing, drainage, deck, topping) and live loads. Headed 'Dana Point Harbor (Bldg 10)'. No balcony element is linked yet.
calcs.loads/wall-types: Exterior wall type weights (thin brick veneer 35 psf, wood siding 15 psf, …) used as line loads and seismic weight.
calcs.loads/tsunami: Tsunami basis of design (CBC 1615 / ASCE 7-16 Ch. 6) for the Risk Category III buildings: inundation, debris impact and hydrostatic foundation loads. Not linked to drawn elements.
calcs.gravity/columns: RISAFloor column forces (dead, floor live, roof) for every column stack, then the hot-rolled steel column code checks (W18X211/283/311 and HSS). HSS names are truncated in the table.
calcs.lateral/model-sketches: RISA-3D sketches of the lateral model: node & boundary labels, member labels, member sizes (SK-5) and SK-6. The sizes are drawn as graphics, so they can't be searched.
calcs.lateral/seismic-loads: Seismic generation input and ELF base shear for a steel special moment frame (SDS 1.012, R = 8, Ie = 1.25), vertical distribution and the X / Z seismic load sketches.
calcs.lateral/drift-check: Story drift check per frame line (1.3, 2.5, 4, A, B, D – the calc grid). The note lists the frame sizes: W18x283 / W18x211 / W18x311 columns, W24x94 at roof, W27x114 at floor, W21x83.
calcs.lateral/risa3d-input: RISA-3D model input: grid lines, nodes, members, sections and load cases for the lateral model. Not linked to drawn elements.
calcs.lateral/risa3d-results: RISA-3D node reactions and envelope displacements. Not linked to drawn elements.
calcs.lateral/smf-code-checks: RISA-3D envelope AISC 360-16 code checks for the SMF members (F1_M…, F2_M…: W21X83, W24X84, W24X94, W27X114, plus the W18 columns).
calcs.foundation/risafoundation-model: RISAFoundation sketch (footings by joint: R3D_N…, FLR_1_N…) and model input – grids, footing sets 'Lateral Ext. Ftn'g.' and 'Gravity Ftn'g.', loads.
calcs.foundation/footing-results: RISAFoundation footing code checks, geometry (4×4, 5×5, 9×9 ft gravity; 9–15 ft lateral), soil pressures, safety factors and shear checks.
calcs.foundation/beam-results: RISAFoundation beam / strip tables. Every table prints 'No Data to Print' – no grade beam is designed in this model.
calcs.studs/wind-cc: Wind coefficients and components & cladding pressures for the exterior studs (ASCE 7-16), plus the Simpson wind modules for the monoslope roof and roof deck.
calcs.studs/opening-a-1-s4.0.1: Simpson CFS Designer model 'Opening A – 1/S4.0.1': wall studs, jamb studs 600S250-54, vertical header 400S162-43, lateral header 600T125-54 and connectors.
calcs.studs/opening-b-2-s4.0.2: Simpson CFS Designer model 'Opening B – 2/S4.0.2': wall studs 600S162-54, boxed vertical header 600S162-54, lateral header 600T150-54 and connectors.
calcs.studs/typical-studs: Typical exterior stud 600S162-54 @ 16" o.c. checked for windward, leeward, uniform and simple-span cases, with connectors.
calcs.studs/high-parapet-mep-well: Simpson CFS model of the high parapet studs at the MEP well (600S162-54 @ 16" o.c. with a 78" cantilever). No drawn element is linked yet.
calcs.studs/high-canopy-hss-bm-10-oc: ENERCALC check of the high canopy HSS beam at 10' o.c. No drawn element is linked yet.
calcs.studs/high-canopy-hss-bm: ENERCALC check of the high canopy HSS beam (continued). No drawn element is linked yet.
calcs.stair/cover: Cover sheet of the 2023 stair & parapet package.
